en.v: Those who are found eating, smoking or lying across the seats on the subway in Beijing can be

examples.zh: 在北京的地铁上吃东西、抽烟或躺在座位上的人，可能会被处以 50 至 500 元的罚款。

errata.original: Those who are found eating, smoking or lying across the seats on the subway in Beijing can be fined between 50 to 500 yuan.
errata.corrected: Those who are found eating, smoking or lying across the seats on the subway in Beijing can be fined between 50 and 500 yuan.
errata.note: 例句 between … to … 搭配错误，应为 between 50 and 500；经人工复核（GitHub #136 第 87 条）确认更正
